app.name: Mashkif
app.tagline: Mashkif · Internet outage map for Israel

home.heading: Is it just me or everyone?
home.privacy: Mashkif watches the network, not you

setup.heading: Create the admin account
setup.intro: Mashkif has one admin. Choose a username, your email address, and a password.
setup.usernameHelp: 3 to 30 characters: English letters, digits, dots, or underscores.
setup.emailHelp: Password reset links go here. Use an address you can always reach.

signIn.heading: Sign in
signIn.totpIntro: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for Mashkif.
signIn.backupIntro: Use one of the backup codes saved when two-step verification was set up. Each code works once.
signIn.useTotp: Use the code from the app instead

totp.heading: Set up two-step verification
totp.intro: Every sign-in needs a code from an authenticator app. Set it up now to continue.
totp.confirmPassword: Confirm your password to create your personal code.
totp.scan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
totp.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
totp.manual: Can't scan? Enter this key in the app:

backupCodes.heading: Backup codes
backupCodes.help: Save these codes somewhere safe now. They are shown only once. If you lose your phone, each code replaces the 6-digit code for one sign-in.

forgot.heading: Forgot your password?
forgot.intro: Enter the admin's email address. If it matches, a link to set a new password is sent there. The link works for one hour.
forgot.sent: If the address belongs to the admin, the link is on its way. It works for one hour. No email? Sending email may not be set up yet; the server log says why.

reset.heading: Set a new password
reset.intro: Choose a new password. Every session ends, and you sign in again with the new password and your code.

account.newEmailHelp: A link goes to the new address. The change takes effect when you open it.
account.emailSent: If sending email is set up, a link went to the new address. Open it to finish the change.
account.backupIntro: New codes replace the old ones. Confirm your password to create them.

passkeys.heading: Passkeys
passkeys.intro: Sign in with your fingerprint, face, or device PIN instead of a password and a code.
passkeys.name: Name (optional)

errors.invalidCredentials: The username or password is wrong.
errors.invalidCode: The code is wrong. Enter the current code from your app.
errors.signInExpired: This sign-in expired. Enter your username and password again.
errors.locked: Too many wrong codes. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait 5 minutes and try again.
errors.passwordTooShort: The password needs at least 12 characters.
errors.passwordTooLong: The password can have at most 128 characters.
errors.usernameInvalid: Use 3 to 30 English letters, digits, dots, or underscores.
errors.alreadySetUp: An admin account exists already. Sign in instead.
errors.invalidBackupCode: That backup code is wrong or was used already.
errors.resetLinkInvalid: This link is invalid, expired, or used already. Ask for a new one.
errors.passkeyFailed: This passkey didn't work. Try again or use your password and a code.
errors.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.originRejected: The request was blocked because it didn't come from this site. Reload the page.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.labelInvalid: Enter a label of up to 100 characters.
errors.tierInvalid: Choose one of the trust tiers.
errors.areaInvalid: That is not an H3 cell at resolution 7.
errors.areaOutside: That cell is outside the service area.
errors.rangeInvalid: Enter an IP address, or a range such as 192.0.2.0/24.
errors.rangeExists: This address or range is blocked already.
errors.nameInvalid: Enter a name of up to 100 characters.
errors.asnsInvalid: Enter ASNs as whole numbers separated by commas, at most 200.
errors.asnTaken: An ASN in the list belongs to another provider. Remove it there first.
errors.providerExists: A provider with this name exists already.
errors.settingInvalid: One of the values is not valid. Check the range under each field.
errors.settingLocked: The server environment sets this value. Change it there.
errors.notFound: It no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.conflict: Something changed at the same time. Reload the page and try again.

agents.heading: Agents
agents.intro: Every PC that registered. A PC registers by itself when Mashkif is installed. Site addresses are visible only here.
agents.empty: No agents yet. Install Mashkif on a PC; it appears here when it registers.
agents.revokeHelp: The PC stops reporting. Its user can choose Join again in the Mashkif app; it then registers as a new agent.
agents.tierHelp: A new PC starts at Low and becomes Normal after its trial. Choosing Low restarts the trial; to hold a PC back for good, choose Suspicious.
agents.trialRule: Becomes Normal after reporting on that many days, while it still reports.
agents.areaHelp: An H3 cell at resolution 7. Leave empty to use the area the agent reports.

blocked.heading: Blocked addresses
blocked.intro: Requests from these addresses and ranges are refused: registration, heartbeats, and events.
blocked.rangeHelp: An IPv4 or IPv6 address, or a range such as 192.0.2.0/24.

providers.heading: Providers
providers.intro: Group network numbers (ASNs) into providers. Each agent shows the provider of its address.
providers.name: Name
providers.asnsHelp: Numbers separated by commas or spaces, for example 64500, 64501.
providers.empty: No providers yet. Agents show only their network until you add one.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.intro: Values live in the database. A value set by the server environment is shown locked.
settings.heartbeatIntervalSecondsHelp: From 30 to 600. Each agent switches at its next heartbeat.
settings.retentionDaysHelp: At least 8. Older data is deleted every hour.
settings.registrationOpenHelp: Open: a PC registers by itself when Mashkif is installed. Closed: new PCs are refused and try again every hour; registered PCs keep reporting.
settings.newAgentTier: Trust tier of a new PC
settings.newAgentTierHelp: Low: a new PC reports but counts in no outage until its trial ends. Normal skips the trial.
settings.promotionDaysHelp: From 1 to 90. A Low PC becomes Normal once it has reported on this many days and still reports in the last 24 hours.
settings.registerPerSitePer10Min: New PCs per address in 10 minutes
settings.registerPerSitePer10MinHelp: From 1 to 1000. One IPv4 address or one IPv6 /64. Raise it before installing many PCs behind one address.
settings.registerGlobalPerHour: New PCs per hour, all addresses
settings.registerGlobalPerHourHelp: From 1 to 100000. When it is used up, new installations wait and try again by themselves, and registered PCs are not affected. Raise it, or close registration during an attack.
settings.eventsPerAgentHourHelp: From 100 to 100000. Events past it stay on the PC and are sent later.
settings.eventsPerLowAgentHour: Events per Low PC per hour
settings.eventsPerLowAgentHourHelp: From 10 to 100000. The same, for PCs in their trial.
settings.agentCleanupDaysHelp: From 7 to 3650. A PC that registered but never sent a heartbeat is deleted after this many days. Revoked PCs are kept.
settings.publicUrlHelp: The address of this site, for example https://mashkif.co.il. Empty: taken from each request. Recommended behind a proxy.
settings.trustedOriginsHelp: Other addresses the admin pages are opened from, separated by commas. Usually empty.
settings.trustedProxiesHelp: IP addresses or CIDR ranges of the reverse proxies whose X-Forwarded-For is believed, separated by commas. Behind Traefik: the subnet that only Traefik and the app share.
settings.sessionHoursHelp: From 1 to 168. A session is never extended.
settings.smtpHostHelp: Host name. Empty: no email is sent.
settings.smtpPortHelp: 465 uses TLS from the start; on other ports the server must offer STARTTLS.
settings.smtpUserHelp: Empty: no sign-in to the server.
settings.smtpPasswordHelp: Stored encrypted and never shown. Leave empty to keep the stored one.
settings.smtpFromHelp: The From address of every email.
settings.applySessions: Applies to sessions that start after a server restart.
settings.locked: Set by the environment variable {{variable}}; change it there.
settings.geoipStale: Built {{date}}, more than two weeks ago. Check the tool that updates the file.
settings.geoipUnavailable: Not loaded. Agents are recorded without a provider until the file can be read.
